dedupe_keys.name: crossbow hlu2 uc4 tc4 simulated curtailments at konjsko substation

description: The CROSSBOW project publishes a Konjsko-substation simulation of generation curtailment decisions. Zenodo serves a CSV under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The page says the experiment evaluated a curtailment-distribution algorithm by applying thirty simulated limitations on randomly selected days to forecast generation associated with the substation. Coverage is the Konjsko substation and its connected generation. These scenarios can test wind-integration constraints and curtailment-allocation methods before use in power-system models. A related CROSSBOW Zenodo deposit contains measured Konjsko voltage and power before, during and after a separate curtailment event; those are observations, not these generated limits. A limitation is that the public page does not state the sample interval, complete input forecasts or scoring metric. Random day selection and the particular grid configuration constrain transfer to other substations. The CSV was not downloaded and no algorithm outcome was recalculated.
